name: Veronica Lombardi
source:
Veronica Lombardi is a Belvoire University student and a potential member of Your Character's Posse. While one of the highest-ranked students on campus, she comes off as significantly less rude about and obsessed with her popularity than other students the player meets. She is more focused on her massive social media presence, often streaming herself at important events talking excitedly to her followers. Once the camera shuts off, however, Veronica immediately reverts back to her normal, stoic self.

While Veronica is not interested in being Your Character's closest friend, she will reciprocate flirting and even have a threesome with Your Character and Carter Jackson if the player chooses to do so. Additionally, she will occasionally provide Your Character with insight on how to achieve various goals, albeit usually to aid her thirst for drama.
